# Rich step display fixture

The source is the [session editor terminal grammar](../terminal.md), including
its normative public starter terminal field enumeration, and the public steps
schema and authoring validator rules. The additive fixture author read those
definitions and existing public helpers, not either implementation, mutation
inventory, private renderer or differential results.

The raw plan and expected terminal block are independent literals. Two real steps
cover every step field, five ordered Run arguments including empty/repeated
ordinary data, three check types, multiline notes with a final empty line and
reverse-authored Z/A environment keys with distinct quoted values. The expected
display requires exact sorted A/Z entries and a genuinely empty second environment.
Global row counts reject extra entries outside the matched literal block.

All example commands, paths and environment names are fake display data. The
current-session exit and actual explicit-answer proposal/cancel paths require
complete expected input consumption, unread trailing input, Clock0, no save and
unchanged native bytes, identities, security, attributes and namespace.

The fixture checks Run display and native/input boundaries, not a universal
process-launch observer or binary-dispatch proof. It does not generate expected
text from the product or change the existing nonexecution requirement.
